meta.name: SMEDA Dashboard Business Plan
meta.tender_pdf: RFP IT T 5 (SMEDA Dashboard Business Plan).pdf
meta.source: human-authored tracker, SMEDA Tasks & Responsibilities Sheet

rows.description: Ensure DPL is registered on EPADS v2.0 and prepare the bid under the Single Stage-Two Envelope procedure using QCBS.
rows.evidence: EPADS registration; technical and financial proposal files
rows.remarks: Submission is electronic through EPADS v2.0.

rows.description: Submit the RFP through EPADS v2.0 by Thursday, 27 August 2026 at 2:00 PM.
rows.remarks: Late/manual submission is not entertained.

rows.description: Proposal language must be English.
rows.remarks: Apply to all forms and supporting narrative.

rows.description: Proposal validity is 120 days.
rows.remarks: Ensure the Bid Securing Declaration remains valid 28 days beyond proposal validity.

rows.description: Submit all listed forms: TECH-1, TECH-4, TECH-5, TECH-6, Bid Securing Declaration, Blacklisting Undertaking, Annexure-A, Annexure-A(1), FIN-1, FIN-2, Technical Forms Checklist and Eligibility Checklist.
rows.evidence: Complete proposal pack in prescribed formats
rows.remarks: Wrong technical proposal format may cause non-responsiveness.

rows.description: Price shall be fixed.
rows.remarks: Avoid conditional or variable pricing.

rows.description: Bid currency shall be PKR.
rows.remarks: All quoted amounts should be in PKR.

rows.description: Submit the proposal online through EPADS v2.0. The RFP also contains wording regarding hard-copy bid security submission; confirm the latest EPADS/addendum instruction before final submission.
rows.remarks: RFP wording is internally inconsistent on Demand Draft vs Bid Securing Declaration; use the prescribed declaration and latest portal instruction.

rows.description: Successful bidder must furnish a 10% performance guarantee.
rows.remarks: Required after award, not part of technical scoring.

rows.description: Provide legal incorporation/registration with the relevant government authority.
rows.remarks: Attach scanned legal registration documents.

rows.description: Provide NTN and STRN/PST registrations.
rows.remarks: Must be valid and match the bidding entity.

rows.description: Provide proof that the firm is on the FBR Active Taxpayer List (ATL).
rows.remarks: Use current ATL evidence.

rows.description: Demonstrate at least 5 years of verifiable relevant experience.
rows.remarks: Separate from the 35-mark specific-project scoring criterion.

rows.description: Demonstrate average annual revenue of at least PKR 50 million over the previous three years.
rows.evidence: Average Annual Turnover Form; audited financial statements / tax returns / bank statements
rows.remarks: Average of the previous three years must meet the threshold.

rows.description: Submit the prescribed non-blacklisting affidavit on legal stamp paper of minimum PKR 100.
rows.evidence: Signed Blacklisting Undertaking on PKR 100 stamp paper
rows.remarks: Use prescribed RFP wording.

rows.description: Submit the prescribed Bid Securing Declaration on legal stamp paper of minimum PKR 100 in favor of SMEDA.
rows.evidence: Signed Bid Securing Declaration on PKR 100 stamp paper
rows.remarks: Declaration should remain valid 28 days beyond proposal validity. If bidding as a JV, the declaration must be in the name of the JV and cover all members.

rows.description: Firm profile: provide documentary evidence of length of incorporation. 10 years or more earns the full 5 marks; less than 10 years is relatively marked.
rows.remarks: Confirm incorporation date and expected score.

rows.description: Identify up to 5 relevant completed projects in web-based dashboards / IT solutions / M&E / progress monitoring / UI / application dashboards, each valued at PKR 15 million or above and completed within the last 5 years.
rows.evidence: Annexure-A project sheets; award letter / contract / completion certificate showing value and duration
rows.remarks: Known gap to validate. Maximum 7 marks per qualifying project, up to 5 projects.

rows.description: Prepare evidence for 5 relevant clients: at least 3 Government-sector clients and 2 Development-sector clients (e.g., UN agencies, JICA, World Bank, ITC or similar).
rows.evidence: Client schedule; award letter / contract / completion certificate / recommendation letter
rows.remarks: Known gap to validate. 2 marks per qualifying client.

rows.description: Prepare Understanding of Assignment showing why SMEDA needs the dashboard, intended users, monitoring objectives, KPI/target/budget needs and decision-making outcomes.
rows.remarks: Proposal-development task; should directly map to TOR objectives.

rows.description: Prepare the Technical Approach covering M&E framework design methodology, platform recommendation rationale, data-entry approach and dashboard architecture quality.
rows.evidence: TECH-4 - Technical Approach; architecture diagram; methodology
rows.remarks: Address all four named sub-areas explicitly.

rows.description: Prepare a detailed, realistic work plan and convert it into the TECH-5 deliverable schedule / bar chart.
rows.evidence: TECH-4 Work Plan; TECH-5 Gantt / bar chart
rows.remarks: Align with 7-month TOR and all deliverables.

rows.description: Prepare for a possible bidder presentation if SMEDA invites the firm.
rows.remarks: Not a separate submission requirement unless invited.

rows.description: Propose up to 4 Key Experts: Team Leader, M&E Specialist, IT & Dashboard Analyst/Developer, and Implementation Support Expert. All proposed Key Experts must have at least 16 years of education in relevant disciplines.
rows.evidence: TECH-6 team composition; signed CVs; degree evidence
rows.remarks: Select strongest available experts because experience bands directly affect marks.

rows.description: Identify Team Leader with advanced degree (Master’s or higher) in MIS / Computer Science or related field, at least 7 years progressive relevant experience, multi-stakeholder experience and at least 3 comparable dashboard/MIS projects.
rows.evidence: TECH-6 CV; degree; project experience and references
rows.remarks: >15 years relevant experience earns 10 marks; >10-15 earns 5; >7-10 earns 1.

rows.description: Identify M&E Specialist with advanced degree in Statistics, Social Sciences, Economics or related discipline and at least 5 years relevant M&E/program performance experience.
rows.remarks: >10 years earns 5; >7-10 earns 3; >5-7 earns 1.

rows.description: Identify IT/Dashboard expert with 16 years education in CS/IT/Software Engineering/IS or related discipline and at least 5 years experience in web applications, MIS, dashboards, databases, integrations and reporting.
rows.evidence: TECH-6 CV; degree; dashboard / MIS assignments
rows.remarks: Relevant certifications are an added advantage. Experience bands: 5 / 3 / 1 marks.

rows.description: Identify Implementation Support Expert with 16 years relevant education and at least 5 years experience in institutional/governance settings, M&E/MIS, dashboards, stakeholder coordination, training and change management.
rows.remarks: Experience bands: >10 years = 5; >7-10 = 3; >5-7 = 1.

rows.description: Plan structured training: at least two half-day workshops for Project Managers, one full-day workshop for Theme Leads, and training for Senior Management.
rows.evidence: Training plan; agendas; materials; user manual; admin guide
rows.remarks: Reflect training methodology and staffing in TECH-4.

rows.description: Plan minimum 3 months post-deployment support after go-live, including issue resolution, query management, minor adjustments, troubleshooting and handover.
rows.remarks: Must be included in the 7-month schedule and pricing.

rows.description: Prepare testing, validation and deployment plan: historical/baseline data loading, UAT with project teams, defect closure and production deployment.
rows.evidence: Test/UAT plan; defect log approach; deployment plan
rows.remarks: Map into TECH-4 and TECH-5.

rows.description: Map all TOR deliverables into the work plan: Inception Report; Data Architecture/Platform Recommendation; Dashboard Prototype; UAT Report; Manuals/Training Materials; Production Deployment; Handover Package; Post-Implementation Support.
rows.remarks: Use the actual TOR deliverables rather than only the placeholder D-1 to D-6 rows in TECH-5.

rows.description: Plan the total 7-month engagement: 4 months for deployment/operationalization and 3 months post-implementation support/troubleshooting.
rows.remarks: No activity should contradict the stated overall duration.

rows.description: Complete and sign the Technical Proposal Submission Form, including bidder/JV details if applicable, proposal validity, declarations and authorized signatory information.
rows.evidence: Signed TECH-1; authority to sign / power of attorney if applicable
rows.remarks: Use the prescribed form without changing its legal declarations.

rows.reference: TECH-1 Attachment - JV Letter of Intent / JV Agreement
rows.description: If bidding as a Joint Venture, identify all JV members and the Lead Member and attach either a signed Letter of Intent to form the JV or an existing JV Agreement signed by every participating member. The document should confirm the JV structure and joint and several liability of the members.
rows.evidence: Signed Letter of Intent to form JV or existing signed JV Agreement
rows.remarks: There is no separate prescribed JV form in the RFP; the JV document is an attachment to TECH-1.

rows.description: If bidding as a JV, prepare the required Powers of Attorney: authority for the authorized representative of each JV member and authority for the Lead Member representative to act/sign on behalf of all JV members. If only the Lead Member signs TECH-1, the relevant POA must be attached.
rows.evidence: Executed Powers of Attorney for JV member representatives and Lead Member representative
rows.remarks: The RFP states that there is no pre-set POA format.

rows.description: If bidding as a JV, submit the proposal through the EPADS v2.0 account of the Lead Member and provide reference to the EPADS accounts/credentials of all JV members as required.
rows.evidence: Lead Member EPADS submission + JV member EPADS references/credentials
rows.remarks: All JV members should be properly identified in the proposal; use the Lead Member account for submission.

rows.description: Prepare the Approach, Methodology and Work Plan using the prescribed structure: Understanding, Technical Approach, Work Plan, and Comments on TORs (if any).
rows.remarks: This form carries the core methodology scoring.

rows.description: Complete the Work Schedule and Planning for Deliverables. List activities/deliverables and show duration in bar-chart form, including approvals and phase benchmarks.
rows.remarks: Align to the 7-month TOR and the eight deliverables.

rows.description: Complete team composition: expert name, position, qualification, years of education and relevant years of experience; list relevant assignments for each expert.
rows.evidence: Completed TECH-6 team and experience tables
rows.remarks: Use exact designation for each proposed expert.

rows.description: Prepare the prescribed CV for each Key Expert, including full work history, relevant/non-relevant assignments, references, professional memberships, language skills, assigned tasks and prior work illustrating capability.
rows.evidence: Four completed TECH-6 CVs with supporting degrees/experience
rows.remarks: The RFP asks for all past assignments, relevant or not relevant, in the CV work history.

rows.description: Obtain each expert’s signature certifying the CV and availability, plus the authorized representative’s signature.
rows.remarks: Do not nominate experts without confirmed availability.

rows.description: Complete prescribed Bid Securing Declaration with date, proposal number, authorized signature, consultant name, address and contact details.
rows.evidence: Original/signed declaration; PKR 100 stamp paper version
rows.remarks: Validity extends 28 days beyond proposal validity. If bidding as a JV, the declaration must be in the name of the JV and cover all members.

rows.description: Complete and sign the prescribed Undertaking Regarding Not Being Blacklisted on PKR 100 stamp paper.
rows.remarks: Confirm SMEDA Blacklisting Policy 2023 has been read and accepted.

rows.description: Complete Applicant Information Form: legal name, year of registration, NTN, top three core business areas, legal status, geographic presence, leadership and authorized contact information.
rows.remarks: Keep all corporate data consistent across TECH-1 and supporting documents.

rows.description: Prepare one Specific Experience project sheet per selected project with title, employer, scope/role, year/duration, cost, contact details, status and magnitude.
rows.evidence: Completed project sheets + supporting evidence placed next to each sheet
rows.remarks: Only projects with verifiable evidence of cost and duration will be considered.

rows.description: Complete Litigation History. If there are no cases, state NIL / None / N/A rather than leaving the table unexplained.
rows.remarks: Ensure consistency with the detailed procurement litigation form on pages 120-121.

rows.description: Complete Financial Proposal Submission Form: total amount in words and figures, inclusive of applicable taxes/duties, validity date and authorized signatory details.
rows.remarks: Keep completely separate from the Technical Proposal.

rows.description: Complete Summary of Costs and ensure the total exactly matches FIN-1. Include all expenses, taxes/duties and contract stamp duty; do not submit an alternative/conditional bid.
rows.remarks: Any alternative/conditional bid may be rejected.

rows.description: Complete the Technical Proposal Standard Forms Checklist covering TECH-1, JV attachment/POA if applicable, TECH-4, TECH-5, TECH-6, Annexure-A and Annexure-A(1).
rows.remarks: Use as final assembly control.

rows.description: Ensure all pages of the original Technical and Financial Proposal are initialed by the same authorized representative who signs the proposal.
rows.evidence: Initialed proposal PDFs / signed originals as applicable
rows.remarks: Perform this only after final pagination and document assembly.

rows.description: Complete the Eligibility Criteria Checklist and place it at the top of the proposal. Insert the exact proposal page number for each supporting document.
rows.remarks: Final page references must be updated after PDF consolidation.

rows.description: Complete the detailed procurement form for historical contract non-performance, debarment, pending litigation and court/arbitral award history. If none, tick the appropriate “not debarred/no consistent history” options and state NIL where applicable. For a JV, complete the form for the Applicant and each JV member.
rows.evidence: Completed form for Applicant; separate completed form for each JV member if applicable
rows.remarks: Complete for the Applicant and each JV member, if bidding as a JV.

rows.description: Complete the Average Annual Turnover form for the relevant years and calculate PKR equivalent/average; support it with the financial evidence required by eligibility criteria. For a JV, the form is to be filled for the Applicant and each JV member.
rows.evidence: Completed turnover form + supporting financial evidence; separate form for each JV member if applicable
rows.remarks: For a JV, the form states it should be filled for the Applicant and each JV member.

rows.description: Assemble the Technical Proposal in the prescribed order, validate all forms/evidence, update page references, check signatures/initials, and confirm no financial price appears in the Technical Proposal.
rows.remarks: Run a second-person QA before upload.

rows.description: Assemble FIN-1 and FIN-2 separately, reconcile totals, verify taxes/expenses are included and remove any conditional wording.
rows.remarks: FIN-1 and FIN-2 must match exactly.

rows.description: Upload the final Technical and Financial submissions through EPADS v2.0, verify each file opens correctly and is placed in the correct envelope/category, then retain submission confirmation.
rows.remarks: Submit ahead of the 2:00 PM deadline to allow time for upload issues.
